title: ATM limits, charges and availability - support procedure
content: Check the configured synthetic card limit and ATM directory before a demonstration withdrawal. For actual fees or foreign-currency treatment, consult the issuer and machine disclosures; this assistant does not quote unconfigured rates or surcharges.
